eligibility: Positive average match-margin improvement in both discovery panels; no fewer aggregate discovery wins than fixed.
ranking: Equal-weight average of natural and controlled-panel margin improvements. Prefer the simpler candidate within 50 margin units of the best eligible score, in static, clock, visible order.
promotion: On untouched confirmation seeds require positive average margin improvement, no fewer total wins than fixed, and more wins than losses in direct matches against fixed.
reason: Freeze selection before inspecting discovery outcomes; do not retune models on these panels.
